decision_rule: run_grace iff s(x) >= s_floor  |  s_floor = Q_alpha(s_oof[ori_wrong - ow_gw])  |  s(x) = GBDT logit (or LR standardized)
notes: Cost-aware Conformal Safe-Skip Router v2. Training uses only (ori_correct, ori_wrong) labels for the classifier. cgw / ow_gw sets are used only to (1) define must-recall, (2) report cgw→ori rate. No hard threshold — s_floor is derived from OOF scores on the must-recall subset at quantile α.
